summary: Shopify-inspired admin product management and complete Shop All nail collection
changes: Rebuilt Shop All with breadcrumb-led hierarchy, a three-column product grid and responsive collection layout
Added collection, availability and naira price filters with clear-filter states
Added eight sort modes: Featured, Newest, Best selling, price, alphabetic and Oldest
Published seven named nail variations using the existing booking-page photography and placeholder naira pricing
Rebuilt the admin Products index with status views, search, counts, selection and bulk deletion
Introduced a Shopify-inspired two-column product editor for content, media, pricing, inventory, status and organization
Added multi-image uploads with a 12-image limit, primary-image treatment and per-image removal
Added permanent product deletion with uploaded-file cleanup and explicit confirmation
Improved responsive behavior, keyboard focus treatment, status badges and WCAG-oriented labeling
deployment: Run the PostgreSQL schema migration during application startup to seed the starter collection
Review and replace placeholder prices from the Products administration workspace
Ensure UPLOAD_DIR is mapped to persistent storage in production
Render should deploy automatically after merge
